{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Atraken Memory''''' was one of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]] used by [[Atrakenite]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] during the evacuation of [[Atraken/Legends|Atraken]] to [[Trilos]]. By [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], it was kept operational by virtue of using another freighter, the ''[[Atraken Hope]]'', as a source of spare parts.
